headline: 10 players who could still move before the transfer window closes
description: Here are 10 players who either really need to find a solution, or promise to be the subject of intense speculation, ahead of the transfer window slamming shut on Sept. 1.

headline: Raheem Sterling charged with dangerous driving after car crash
description: Former England forward Raheem Sterling has been charged with dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway, police have said.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Man United to hold Balde talks
description: Manchester United are set to open negotiations with Barcelona over the signing of defender Alejandro Balde. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Oliver Glasner: 'I'm no messiah,' Nottingham Forest 'ignored reality'
description: Nottingham Forest boss Oliver Glasner says the club have "ignored reality" after losing to Leeds for the second time in three days.

headline: Liverpool reignite Bradley Barcola talks with PSG - sources
